# A read at a negative constant offset in a loop with a constant limit is rewritten
# while the last index it reads is at least zero. When every index is below zero
# (a[i-16] in a loop that stops before 16), the scalar loop panics on its first
# iteration and the length check of the vector loop would be a negative constant
# index, which does not compile, so the loop is left alone. The rewritten package
# must build.

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

loopvec -split .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go build .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func LastIndexZero(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-15] + 1
	}
}

func EveryIndexNegative(dst, a []int32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-16] + 1
	}
}

func FarBelow(dst, a []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		dst[i] = a[i-20] * a[i]
	}
}
-- stdout.want --
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":4,"func":"LastIndexZero","vectorized":true}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":10,"func":"EveryIndexNegative","vectorized":false,"reason":"a constant offset puts every index below zero","stage":"lower"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":16,"func":"FarBelow","vectorized":false,"reason":"a constant offset puts every index below zero","stage":"lower"}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
